# Varnish Renamed to Vinyl-Cache

As of version 9.0.0, www-servers/varnish has been renamed to
www-servers/vinyl-cache in line with upstream's change of name[0][1][2][3].

# Changes

All binaries have been renamed:

 varnishd                  -> vinyld
 varnishlog                -> vinyllog

# Upgrading

Update configuration under /etc/conf.d/vinyld before restarting.
